<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**6** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `597e32722a2e58778bfe4ec538f091b81a66e19f` — the merge of head `5adfbc1411507f5dc80f9004b4902a5f8031663a` into base `6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 597e32722a2e58778bfe4ec538f091b81a66e19f && git checkout 597e32722a2e58778bfe4ec538f091b81a66e19f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703 5adfbc1411507f5dc80f9004b4902a5f8031663a && git checkout -B drift-repro 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703 && git merge --no-ff 5adfbc1411507f5dc80f9004b4902a5f8031663a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5adfbc1411507f5dc80f9004b4902a5f8031663a`
Local-runs: none

PR #23098, the fold of #23004 and #23005 on branch `claude/issue-23004-empty-state-link`, reviewed against the net diff from merge-base `6662e3f59` (16 files, +604/−25), the two cards' bodies and every comment on them, and the head's check-runs, read at 2026-10-12T21:43Z. Nothing was built, run or re-run. Git objects were read for the diff, for `navigation-target.ts` and `strict-object.ts` at the head, for `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` and `undrilled-containers.baseline.json` at base and head, and for objectui at the pin `7578323` and at `7af0ab3`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`EmptyStateSchema.link` — RIGHT.** One optional key, a module-private `strictObject` `{ label: I18nLabel, url: string }`, both required, closed: any extra key, `action` included, is `unrecognized_keys` at `link`. A link only; nothing on it invokes an action, flow or script. This is the shape the consumer card asked for and triage's direction (`6122915275`) ordered.
2. **`link.url` accept set — RIGHT; one grammar reused, not copied.** `view.zod.ts` imports `navigationTargetRefusal` from `./navigation-target` by relative import; `navigation-target.ts` is not in the file list (unchanged since `9b37edbd7`), and `action.zod.ts` calls the same function for a `type: 'url'` action's `target`. The accept set is therefore exactly the runner's: `/` and `./` paths (minus `//host` and `/` followed by a backslash), `http://`, `https://` and `mailto:` with the scheme compared case-insensitively, and a `${`-prefixed template deferred to the click. The empty string is refused once by `.min(1)` (`too_small`); the superRefine skips it so the author reads one issue. The §3 pin (27 targets; the link's verdict and reason equal the action's once the subjects are set aside) is the right pin for "no second grammar".
3. **Aliases and guidance — RIGHT; no widening.** `strictObject`'s `aliases` on the link (`href`/`to`/`target` to `url`, `text`/`title` to `label`) and the `guidance` entries are consulted only to word the `unrecognized_keys` refusal (`strict-object.ts`); they admit nothing, and §4 pins `href` refused with the pointer. The new `url`/`href` guidance entries on `EmptyStateSchema` name keys the shape does not declare, as `alias-integrity` requires. `EMPTY_STATE_ACTION_GUIDANCE` is restated to the link and keeps the `addRecord` pointer, as triage asked.
4. **Every door that carries `EmptyStateSchema` widens by reference — RIGHT, and correctly enumerated.** `ListViewSchema.emptyState`, `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid'].emptyState`, the new `InterfacePageConfigSchema.emptyState`, and every composition that reaches a list view (`Object.listViews`, `View`, `ViewItem`, `ViewItemWire`, `Page`, the `api/*` responses and the `system/*` operations). The 18 new `x-dropped-refinements` sites are exactly that reach, one `link.url` site per published schema.
5. **`InterfacePageConfigSchema.emptyState` — RIGHT.** `EmptyStateSchema.optional()` by reference; §3 of the page pin holds the member to `EmptyStateSchema._zod.def` by identity, so a later copy reds. Triage's "no second empty-state shape" (`6122932405`) holds. A `type: 'list'` page refuses an unknown key inside it at `interfaceConfig.emptyState` and a bad target at `interfaceConfig.emptyState.link.url`, pinned by code and path, with a lit control on the config's own unknown key.
6. **Published JSON Schema — RIGHT.** `link.url` projects as `type: string, minLength: 1`; the grammar is a function outside the closed list in `refinement-projection.ts`, so it is a dropped refinement and not a `pattern` (a regex projection would be the second grammar triage ruled out). `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` at the head: 228 entries and 731 sites, counted by me from the file and equal to its `measured` line; the base held 227 and 713; the delta is one new entry (`ui/EmptyState`) plus the 18 sites of item 4. The hand-resolution after the #23062 merge is certified by the head's check-runs, not by the PR's prose: **Build Core** success (the spec `build` runs `build-schemas.ts`, which refuses a baseline whose line does not match the sites) and **Type Check · source gates** success (`check:authorable-surface`, which is `build-schemas.ts --check`, and `check:generated --reconcile-only`).
7. **Generated artifacts — RIGHT.** `authorable-surface/ui.json` gains `ui/EmptyState:link` and `ui/InterfacePageConfig:emptyState`; the strictness counts shard moves `ui/` 213 to 214, strict 202 to 203, `view.zod.ts` 59 to 60 (the one new `strictObject`, the link); `content/docs/references/{ui/view,ui/page,ui/component,data/object,api/protocol}.mdx` carry the new nested-shape tables. No `api-surface/` change, consistent with a module-private link schema and no new export; `check:api-surface` rides **Type Check · consumer gates**, in_progress when read.
8. **Public types — RIGHT.** `EmptyState` gains `link?: { label; url }` and `InterfacePageConfig` gains `emptyState?`. No transform, so the input/parsed isomorphism holds. Additive only; nothing a consumer wrote stops compiling.
9. **Liveness — RIGHT, as narrow as the enforcement (Prime Directive #10).** Both new keys carry `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` in their describe, the author-facing channel, and it reaches the generated references. Zero readers, verified by me in objectui at the pin `7578323` and at `7af0ab3`: `ListView.tsx:5689-5696` reads `title`, `message` and `icon`; `ObjectGrid.tsx:6647` the same; `InterfaceListPage.tsx:503` passes `view.emptyState`; no `emptyState.link`, `emptyState.action` or `interfaceConfig.emptyState` read anywhere under `packages/`. The ledger rows stay `live` for the container with a note that excludes the planned member; a gate-read `planned` row is not reachable because `view/list.emptyState` and `page/interfaceConfig` are both rows of `undrilled-containers.baseline.json` at the head. **Spec property liveness** success covers `check:liveness` and `check:empty-state`.
10. **Form reconciliation omit row — RIGHT.** The page form does not offer `interfaceConfig.emptyState`; the row says why and names its removal trigger (objectstack-ai/objectui#12270). A Studio control for a value nothing draws would be the advertised-but-undelivered shape #10 forbids.
11. **The reworded `link.url` describe and the changeset sentence (round `9a6bebdd8` plus `5adfbc141`) — RIGHT; they still say what the accept set does.** The describe admits `/` or `./` paths and `http://`, `https://` or `mailto:` addresses; refuses any other scheme, `//host`, a bare relative path, and a tab, line feed or carriage return; and defers a `${…}` template to the click, after interpolation. That is `navigationTargetRefusal` in words, and both code spans (`${…}` and `${ctx.origin}/docs`) are brace-balanced, which is what `escape-mdx.test.ts` refused on `eb4d7de12`. The changeset is the fuller statement and also names `/` followed by a backslash, `http:` without `//`, and the empty url. One describe nit, not a contract error: the describe does not list the `/` + backslash refusal (the changeset and the predicate's own refusal text do); it rides the next touch of that describe.
12. **Contract-first (Prime Directive #12) — RIGHT.** The fix is at the producer contract, refused at parse with the reason and the fix; no consumer leniency, no `??`, and no conversion-layer entry owed, since nothing was renamed or retired.

Checked and acceptable without a line of its own: `label` is `I18nLabelSchema`, so an empty-string label parses exactly as `title` and `message` do today; the translation group's `_views.VIEW.emptyState` is a separate `{ title, message }` shape and is untouched; no governed surface is in the file list (**Governed Surface Queue Guard** success).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23004-empty-state-link.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`. Right. The diff publishes two new accepted keys on an already-released package; nothing is removed, renamed or narrowed, so no migration text and no ADR-0087 marker are owed, and `minor` is both the floor `Clause-②: yes` takes and the level this diff deserves. No other released package changes (`content/docs` and `docs/audits` publish nothing). **Check Changeset** success on the head.

`Clause-②: yes (widening: two new accepted keys)` stands at line start in the PR body and in the changeset body, the same arm in both, well-formed (`yes` with the `(widening)` arm; neither `(narrowing)` nor the malformed `no (widening)`). It matches what the diff publishes.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev report (`6132575593`) carries `open_questions: []`. Its seven deviations and four out-of-scope findings, each answered:

- **D1, two files outside the claimed surface** (the `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` omit row and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`): both gate-forced, both stated in the PR body, both the minimum the gate demanded. Accepted (items 6 and 10).
- **D2, `publishedSchemasWithDroppedRefinements` hand-corrected from git's 227 to 228:** verified by recount and certified by Build Core and Type Check · source gates (item 6). Accepted.
- **D3, the narrowed local re-run after the second merge:** CI runs the full set. **Test Core (1/6) to (6/6)**, **Type Check · workspace** and **Type Check · consumer gates** were in_progress when read; no check-run on this head has failed. The seat reads convergence separately; this verdict is about the contract.
- **D4, liveness by describe marker plus row note, with no gate-read `planned` row:** the right mechanism given the undrilled containers (item 9); drilling `view/list.emptyState` is a separate edit to `undrilled-containers.baseline.json`, carried with the renderer landing.
- **D5, commit trailers in AGENTS.md's form, and D6, the cli unit run moved to the background:** process notes with no contract bearing.
- **D7, a contract review owed before the queue:** this record.
- **OOS1, the `object-grid` door now accepts `link` while objectstack-ai/objectui#12270 named only `ListView` and `InterfaceListPage`:** the widening is inherent to by-reference reuse, and the describe already names "the console's empty-state renderers" as the planned readers. The seat's ACCEPT (`6132626774`) says it adds the grid to #12270; that card is outside this brief's inputs, so the carriage is recorded as the seat's and not verified here. Escalated to the seat as a one-line confirmation before landing; not a contract defect.
- **OOS2, `component.zod.ts`'s `object-grid` `emptyState` describe lists `{ title, message, icon }`:** an under-claim, the safe direction under #10, and the generated nested-shape table below it already lists `link`. Carrier: the next PR touching that describe. Accepted.
- **OOS3, `link.label` has no translation-bundle address:** the inline locale map is a first-class I18nLabel route and the describe says so. Not a contract violation; extending `os i18n extract` is a follow-up the seat may file when the renderer lands.
- **OOS4, the marker, notes and omit-row removal when the renderer lands:** carried by objectstack-ai/objectui#12270's landing.

Nothing escalates to the maintainer.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-23004-empty-state-link`
Reviewed-by: `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ`

**VERDICT: PASS**
